When a resolver selects a checker or replacement value, this mutates `expectedResolved` after `setState()` computed `provenance.record_sha256`, but the hash is never recomputed before the extraction is written to the verification ledger and staging shard. Recomputing hashes with the repository's `serialize` recipe shows that 54 committed `resolver_verified` rows in `verified-structural-staging-shard.v1.json` have hashes that do not match their contents, so downstream integrity checks will reject these verified records.

When the `activate` command is replayed from the finalized batch, this resolves to `active-pre-provider-freeze.after-1658.v2.json` because the shared batch configuration now names the maker-resume pointer. On a clean checkout, this test reads records from `checker.SHARD3_V3_ROOT`, which resolves under `$HOME/.local/share/cie9709/...` rather than to a committed fixture; those canonical records and the shard 1/2 manifests are not present in the repository.
